proposal.reason: Primary change is in tuning: CollNet is retired from algorithm/protocol selection while keeping slot 2 reserved and forcing safe fallback when tuner selections are CollNet or invalid. Additional substantive changes remove executable CollNet device kernels and function-table entries (kernels), remove CollNet topology graph construction/search/connection paths (graph-search), remove CollNet plugin loading and proxy/network-side handling (network), remove CollNet transport setup/connect/resource flows and transport registry wiring (transport), and update v1 external tuner-facing algorithm constants/compatibility semantics without ABI layout changes (tuner-plugin).
